phases.name: Foundation
phases.do: Pilot, store + payments ready, stock confirmed in writing, 12 accounts warmed up, 14 videos ready in stock.
phases.else: Fix the page and price before adding volume.

phases.name: Volume test
phases.do: 30–40 recycled videos a day on 12 accounts; find the 3 hooks that sell.
phases.else: Start a second product from Top 10.

phases.name: Scale
phases.do: Only winning hooks, 20+ accounts, winners re-cut in Spanish and German.
phases.else: Move all production to the 3 hooks that sell.

phases.name: Peak
phases.do: Black Friday + Christmas offer, delivery date before Christmas on the page, ~450 orders a day.

variants.name: Grumpy green robe
variants.why: Our HeatGrump robe. Same format as the 8.5M grumpy-green viral; references and fixed clips already done.
variants.refs: Ready — HeatGrump library (robe, box, controller, connector, motion clips).
variants.ip: Never write 'Grinch' anywhere. Say 'grumpy green', 'HeatGrump', 'Christmas grump'. Keep a no-face version ready in case of a claim.

variants.name: Princess robe
variants.why: Best average in the whole robe category: @princesscomfortt 1.38M avg, 26M / 15M / 7.8M tops. Same order as our HeatGrump video (drop-open → put on → plug → controller → cozy).
variants.refs: Not yet — product sheet with Higgsfield, Szasz approves (rule 13 Oct).

daily: Morning: Claude reads yesterday's numbers (rezultate) and picks today's hooks.
Make 6–7 new hooks with Genjutsu (480p test ~12 credits, final ~44) ≈ 350 credits ≈ $20.
Add free hooks cut from clips we already have (drop-open moment, lights 1→5, unboxing, grumpy face).
Put each hook on 4–5 different bodies → 30–40 unique videos.
Hand each poster their videos: different combo per account, 2–3 posts per account, 3+ hours apart, + trial reel.
Evening: posters log links; next day more combos on the best hook, drop the weakest 5.

risks.name: Payments frozen
risks.do: Talk to the payment processor before volume; have a second one ready; tracking on every order.

risks.name: Stock for ~11,000 robes
risks.do: Supplier capacity confirmed in writing, both variants.

risks.name: Christmas delivery
risks.do: US warehouse for December orders, or a clear last-order date on the page.

risks.name: Trademark / IP
risks.do: No 'Grinch', no Disney look; generic princess; no-face version ready.

risks.name: Accounts held back
risks.do: No stolen content, no fake reviews, same file never twice; follow platform AI-content rules.

risks.name: Cash for stock
risks.do: Know how much we pay the supplier before payouts arrive.
